chunks: It is He who sent down the sense of security into the hearts of believers so that their faith may increase with belief, -- God's are the armies of the heavens and the earth; and God is all-knowing and all-wise; --
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of Sakinah sent down to the believers' hearts?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the event of the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah, where the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and his companions experienced divine tranquility amidst the anxiety of the truce. The 'Sakinah' is understood not merely as emotional calm but as a spiritual fortification that deepens their conviction (Iman) through the assurance of Allah's ultimate power, as affirmed by the phrase 'for Allah are the forces of the heavens and the earth.'
